title: Find a place and fix its label
description: Drill Explore down to a place, open the system it holds, and rename the place from Configure. The new label follows everywhere the place is read.

steps.caption: Explore is the outline of every place in the fleet, with what each one holds.
Open a building. Each place inside reads its type, and the standard its system is built to.
Bay 3 holds one system, so opening the place opens that system.
The system's panel names the place it sits in, above its own facts.
Expand the panel to the system's full view.
A place holding one system has no page of its own. The system's view is titled by it, with the place as a card below.
Configure holds the place's form first, then the system's.
The place's label was rendered by a label rule from its name.
Edit the place, apart from its system.
Click the label to take it over from the rule.
The label is yours now; the rule no longer rewrites it.
Say what the site calls it, so operators find it by that word.
Saved. Back to the system's overview.
The view's title follows the new label at once.
Back to Explore, opened down to the place you were on.
The outline reads the new label too. One place, one label, wherever it is read.
